title: Web UI: Fix static assets serving (MIME type error)
description:
Frontend built successfully but JavaScript modules fail to load due to MIME type mismatch. Server returns text/html instead of application/javascript for /assets/*.js files.

Error: 'Expected a JavaScript-or-Wasm module script but the server responded with a MIME type of text/html'

Root Cause:
- FastAPI catch-all route @app.get('/{full_path:path}') intercepts /assets/ requests
- Returns index.html for all non-matched routes instead of letting StaticFiles handle it
- Need to exclude /assets/ from catch-all or reorder route registration

Fix Required:
- Move static file mounting before catch-all route, OR
- Add conditional check in catch-all to skip /assets/ paths, OR  
- Use StaticFiles html=True parameter

Files Affected:
- evaluation/web/backend/web_main.py (route order)

Testing:
- npm run build creates files in evaluation/web/static/
- Navigate to http://localhost:8000
- Console should not show MIME type errors
- Frontend should load and connect to WebSocket
